title: ChemInform Abstract: Hydrothermal Synthesis and Crystal Structure of a Novel Rare‐Earth Tungsten Phosphate Supramolecular Compound.
abstract: AbstractLight green crystals of (H2bpy)2 [Eu(H2O)3(PW11O39)] ·6H2O (bpy: 4,4′‐bipyridine) are hydrothermally synthesized from a mixture of Na2WO4, Na2HPO4, Eu2O3, bpy, and H2O (pH 4 adjusted with HNO3, 170 °C, autoclave, 5 d).
